name: astro-template-builder
description: Builder for the Astro templates. Edit files under builder/, then run npm run sync.

scripts.dev: npm run sync && concurrently -k -n sync,blog,lp -c gray,magenta,cyan "node scripts/sync-templates.mjs --reverse --watch" "npm run dev -w @astro-template/blog -- --port 4321" "npm run dev -w @astro-template/lp -- --port 4322"
scripts.dev:blog: npm run sync -- --template blog && concurrently -k -n sync,astro -c gray,magenta "node scripts/sync-templates.mjs --template blog --reverse --watch" "npm run dev -w @astro-template/blog"
scripts.dev:lp: npm run sync -- --template lp && concurrently -k -n sync,astro -c gray,magenta "node scripts/sync-templates.mjs --template lp --reverse --watch" "npm run dev -w @astro-template/lp"
scripts.sync:strict: node scripts/sync-templates.mjs && npm run lint:fix && npm run format && node scripts/sync-templates.mjs --reverse
